admission.justification: Unit tests verify read-only Git root enforcement, detached HEAD handling, dual comparator parsing, digest pinning and fail-closed AuditInputError behavior, preventing corrupted or partial provenance pins.

applicability: Read-only provenance collection over local riemann-hypothesis and optional alpoge-rh-replay Git checkouts in src/rh_pipeline/audit/provenance.py.
conditions: Both upstream_root and optional replay_root must be Git repository roots verified via git rev-parse without mutating either checkout.

Root comparator.json must exist, carry no unknown keys outside the allowed set and include at least one of external_kernels, definition_names or enable_nanoda; when comparator/ exists it must be a directory containing comparator/formal-conjectures.json, and when absent comparator_file_digests is empty.

Tracked note digests hash all existing files in {CONTENTS.md, GUIDE.md, INDEX.md, README.md, REFERENCES.md, verification/NOTES.md, verification/static-scan.txt}, requiring at least verification/NOTES.md or GUIDE.md and both verification/ files whenever verification/ exists; both replay files must exist and parse validly when replay_root is supplied.
exclusions: Does not execute Lake or Lean, does not reject uncommitted upstream dirtiness, and excludes root comparator.json from comparator_file_digests.
statement: collect_provenance reads upstream Git HEAD/branch (including detached HEAD), lean-toolchain, Mathlib rev, root comparator.json plus optional comparator/ config and recursive digests, tracked documentation/verification note digests (requiring verification/NOTES.md or GUIDE.md and paired verification/ files when present), and optional ReplayPin read-only while failing closed with AuditInputError on missing or invalid inputs.
title: Read-only upstream and replay provenance collection with fail-closed validation
